import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
df['m'] = pd.to_datetime(df['ChargePeriodStart']).dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
print(df['m'].value_counts())
p = df.pivot_table(index='ResourceId', columns='m', values='BilledCost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
aug, sep = '2026-08','2026-09'
d = (p[sep]-p[aug]).sort_values()
print(d.tail(5))
print(d.head(5))
